component.name: Ambient
component.summary: Wallpaper generator with patterns, emoji, and AI

description.p: Ambient is a cross-platform wallpaper generator. Pick colors, pick a pattern type, render at your exact screen resolution, apply.
The headline feature is iOS-style emoji wallpapers using Microsoft Fluent 3D emojis, rendered pixel-perfect on Linux. Five pattern types:

ul.li: Mesh gradient — soft, multi-color radial blobs
Emoji — iPhone-style staggered grids with rotation and mirror
Library — pull random images from NASA APOD (free), Unsplash, or Pexels
Generate — AI-generated wallpapers via Pollinations (free) or OpenAI DALL-E 3 (BYOK)

description.p: Native COSMIC desktop integration — Ambient writes directly to cosmic-bg's config so wallpapers apply at the correct physical pixel size on HiDPI displays without zoom or distortion.
Initial pre-release. Patterns generator + Fluent 3D emoji wallpapers + curated sources + BYOK AI generation. COSMIC desktop fully supported.
